entities.title: Saving
entities.summary: The playing and the saved pilot, the name rules, and the pilot record format with its accept and reject rules.
entities.purpose: Keeps the two copies of the pilot (RULES A.7.3), applies the name prompt's rules (D.6.12), writes a record in LodeStar's own text format and decides whether a record read back is accepted (A.8, D.12, deliberate difference 11). It owns the PilotStore trait that infrastructure implements.
boundaries: A feature: it uses capabilities and other features, never a use case (tests/layers.rs).
It never touches a disk: records go through PilotStore.
